compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

The current reconciler has typed `MutationDirection` and `MutationAction`, but `Mutation.payload` remains `Mapping[str, Any]`. Outbound typed mutations are translated back into the legacy batch dictionary, two CREATE shapes coexist, and string/monkeypatch consumers make deletion non-local. ADR 0103 already owns retry, coordinator, and observe-before-replay policy; this story must not redesign those decisions.

This is the architecture prerequisite for the typed cutover. It completes RESEARCH and any required ADR lifecycle before dependent implementation begins.

## Approach

- Enumerate every valid `(direction, action)` pair, producer, consumer, serialization/manifest field, compatibility re-export, string import, standalone-loaded test module, and transport boundary. Use semantic references plus string search.
- Define the smallest discriminated payload union that makes invalid field/action combinations unrepresentable while preserving necessary provenance and canonical comparison.
- Decide ownership of payload validation, canonical serialization, adapter projection, follow-ons/suppression, binding identity, and provider-neutral outcomes.
- Specify expand/compare/cut/delete sequencing, rollback, and exact legacy deletion targets. Production dual-send is forbidden.
- Reconcile the design with ADRs 0004, 0026–0029, 0083, 0092, and 0103. If a new structural decision is required, complete the architecture-decision RESEARCH -> critique -> DRAFT -> HOLD -> MERGE lifecycle before closing this story.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` — mutation producers, planners, coordinator, adapters, manifests, and compatibility surfaces.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` — consumer census and existing contract evidence.
- `docs/adr/` — one atomic decision record only if accepted ADRs do not already decide the representation boundary.

## Testing

This story produces architecture evidence rather than production behavior. Verify the consumer census with both Serena semantic references and repository text search; verify the direction/action matrix against the enum allowlist and every planner/adapter route; run plan review on the resulting implementation stories after the ADR disposition is settled.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A checked-in or ticket-recorded census covers every mutation producer/consumer and all string, dynamic-load, monkeypatch, manifest, and transport consumers; an empty semantic result is confirmed by text search.
- [ ] Every valid direction/action pair has a named payload contract with required/optional fields and validation rules; no proposed contract relies on one option-heavy generic action payload.
- [ ] The design states which current canonical bytes/hashes are compatibility requirements and which normalized representation is comparison-only.
- [ ] Retry/idempotency/fuse ownership remains with ADR 0103's coordinator; no adapter or payload type introduces a second retry owner.
- [ ] Shadow comparison is side-effect-free, and live comparison uses isolated Jira targets/instances rather than dual-sending to one issue.
- [ ] The migration has explicit entry/exit criteria and names `_mutation_to_batch_dict`, legacy batch dispatch, duplicate CREATE handling, obsolete re-exports, and compatibility tests as deletion targets.
- [ ] Any required ADR is merged with explicit approval before dependent code work; otherwise the evidence records why accepted ADRs already decide the shape.
